name: zh-reply
description: Makes Claude and its agents reply in Chinese (Traditional by default), and asks for a rewrite when a reply comes back in another language.

variant.title: Chinese variant
variant.description: zh-TW: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.

enforce.title: When a reply is not in Chinese
enforce.description: rewrite: ask Claude to say it again in Chinese, once (one extra turn). remind: show a notice and remind Claude with your next prompt.

scope.title: Who it applies to
scope.description: all: the main conversation, subagents and teammates. main: the main conversation only.
